title: Review of the CIPS fuel-limited lattice negative on fresh seed 7: e0 0.18 / kF 0.08 again freezes into a static lattice (14 bodies, 0 splits, 0 merges, 0 deaths in 15000 t), and the intermediate kF 0.12 does the same (15 bodies)
summary: c40's layered CIPS world unchanged, 128^2, seed 7, t=15000, labkit default lineage window. WORLD_P e0 0.18, kF 0.08: 14 bodies nucleate by t~1300 into a near-hexagonal lattice and stay, 14 persistent tracks, 0 splits, 0 merges, no deaths (rerun_kF008/seed7/sheet.png). An intermediate point the finding left open, kF 0.12 at e0 0.18, gives the same frozen lattice with 15 bodies and 0 splits or deaths. The negative replicates and extends to kF 0.12: the turnover regime, if it exists, lies between kF 0.12 and the default 0.2 or needs a lower e0.

observations.D: rerun_kF008/seed7: 14 persistent tracks, splits 0, merges 0 to t=15000; rerun_kF012/seed7: 15 tracks, splits 0

seeds_run.result: pass: frozen lattice, 0 splits, 0 deaths (kF 0.08); same at kF 0.12

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed; I did not re-run kF 0.04. The negative is about these parameter points, not about fuel limitation in general.
